what.text: This page follows refugees from the Republic of the Congo living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 410 refugees from the Republic of the Congo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3.1% of all refugees from the Republic of the Congo.
France hosts the most refugees from the Republic of the Congo, followed by South Africa, the United States and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Congo in 1993, from 1997 to 1999 and in 2002 and 2016.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1997 to 1999, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1997 at its highest figure, 20212 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
These are year-end totals for the Democratic Republic of the Congo only, reported to UNHCR.
